seq = open('region.fasta').read()
lines = seq.strip().split('\n')
bases = ''.join(lines[1:]).upper()

def revcomp(s):
    comp = {'A':'T','T':'A','G':'C','C':'G','N':'N'}
    return ''.join(comp[b] for b in reversed(s))

def longest_orf(b, startcodons=('ATG',), stopcodons=('TAA','TAG','TGA')):
    best = (0,0,0,'')  # (length, start, end, frame)
    n = len(b)
    i = 0
    while i <= n-3:
        if b[i:i+3] in startcodons:
            j = i
            while j+3 <= n:
                if b[j:j+3] in stopcodons:
                    break
                j += 3
            length = j - i
            if length > best[0]:
                best = (length, i, j, '')
            i += 3  # skip to next codon
        else:
            i += 1
    return best

print("=== Forward frames ===")
for f in range(3):
    sub = bases[f:]
    # trim to multiple of 3
    sub = sub[:len(sub)-(len(sub)%3)]
    lo = longest_orf(sub)
    print(f"frame +{f+1}: longest ORF {lo[0]} bp, start {lo[1]+f+1}, end {lo[2]+f}")

print("=== Reverse frames ===")
rc = revcomp(bases)
for f in range(3):
    sub = rc[f:]
    sub = sub[:len(sub)-(len(sub)%3)]
    lo = longest_orf(sub)
    print(f"frame -{f+1}: longest ORF {lo[0]} bp, (rc pos) start {lo[1]+f+1}, end {lo[2]+f}")

# search for start codons overall
print("ATG count (forward):", bases.count('ATG'))
print("ATG count (rc):", rc.count('ATG'))
